svg.title: One Redis Pub/Sub channel per geohash cell
svg.desc: On the left, a street map split by a geohash grid into four cells: 9q8zn3 and 9q8zn9 on top, 9q8zn2 and 9q8zn8 below. Seven green dots mark users, three of them labelled user1, user2 and user3, spread across the cells. A wide arrow points right to a Redis Pub/Sub panel holding four channels drawn as cylinders, one per cell: Geohash 9q8zn3, Geohash 9q8zn9, Geohash 9q8zn2 and Geohash 9q8zn8. Each cell of the map maps to exactly one channel, so a client subscribes only to the channels for the cells it cares about.

g.text: Map tiles by Stamen Design, under CC BY 3.0. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
